metadata.case_name: IQBAL ZAFAR v. HONG YIP SERVICE CO LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: storage work and deliveryman (Sports Action Development Ltd); undertook duties similar to night watchman

injuries.description: Struck his head in the fall and sustained injuries to his neck and lower back.
source: in addition to the chemical burns Mr Zafar struck his head in the fall and sustained injuries to his neck and lower back.

injuries.description: a quite unsightly hypertrophic scar on the left side of his neck.
source: a quite unsightly hypertrophic scar on the left side of his neck.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the neck

injuries.description: As a result of these events Mr Safar suffered chemical burns on his face, eyes, left upper limbs, both lower limbs and his back. In short, he sustained second-degree chemical burns over 30% of his total body surface.
injuries.body_part: face; eyes; left upper limbs; both lower limbs; back
source: As a result of these events Mr Safar suffered chemical burns on his face, eyes, left upper limbs, both lower limbs and his back. In short, he sustained second-degree chemical burns over 30% of his total body surface.

manifestations.description: unsightly hypertrophic neck scar causing embarrassment and adverse effect on private life with his wife
scarring on his body restricts movement as it goes taut when stretched
left eye tends to water when it is hot and windy causing him pain
restriction in ability to undertake heavy lifting
uncomfortable to go swimming and to wear clothing exposing the scarring

treatments_future: operation to repair the hypertrophic scar on his neck

losses.description: The cosmetic and physical effects of the burns, injuries and scars ... the residual scarring is extensive and singularly unattractive; adverse effect on private life with his wife.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Would find it very uncomfortable to go swimming as he used to, or to wear clothing, which exposed the extent of the scarring.
He suffers low back pain. The scarring on his body restricts his movement as it goes taut when stretched.
His left eye tends to water when it is hot and windy causing him pain.
I accept completely that the scarring will have had an adverse effect on Mr Zafar’s private life with his wife.
